styles.description: Facade styles (config/facade_styles.json) whose maps get overhead lines unless map.json says otherwise

highways.description: OSM highway values a line of poles follows

spacing_m.description: Distance between two poles along a street

kerb_m.description: How far past the half width of the street a pole stands

back_m.description: Free width kept between a pole and the building behind it

min_axis_m.description: A pole nearer the street's centre line than this is not placed

crossarm_m.description: Length of the crossarm across the line

max_span_m.description: Two poles further apart than this are not wired

sag_ratio.description: Sag of a wire at mid-span, as a share of its length

drops_per_pole.description: Service drops from one pole to the facades near it

drop_reach_m.description: How far from its pole a facade may take a drop

drop_min_z_m.description: A drop lands on the facade no lower than this

drop_max_z_m.description: nor higher than this, and 0.4 m under the building's top

clear_m.description: Radius kept clear round a pole of doors, street lamps and the other props
